userStories.title: Create SettlementService for Calculations
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service to calculate settlement report data.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SettlementService.swift in Booki/Services/

Create struct PlayerSettlementReport with: player (Player), startingBalance (Decimal), netBetResults (Decimal), paymentsReceived (Decimal), adjustments (Decimal), endingBalance (Decimal), betsSettledCount (Int), betsWonCount (Int), betsLostCount (Int)
Add static function calculatePlayerReport(player:periodStart:periodEnd:bets:ledgerEntries:) -> PlayerSettlementReport
startingBalance = sum of ledger entries before periodStart for this player
netBetResults = sum of settlement entries within period
paymentsReceived = sum of payment entries within period
adjustments = sum of adjustment entries within period
endingBalance = startingBalance + netBetResults - paymentsReceived + adjustments
Note: positive balance means player owes bookie
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Pure calculation service - derives data from existing ledger
